title: Bless Residency
shortDescription: 2 & 3 BHK carpet-area homes in Vasai West at a flat ₹11,500 per sq ft — 86 residences on 4.97 acres with 25+ amenities, possession December 2027.
fullDescription: Bless Residency is an under-construction, RERA-registered residential project by Trinity Developers in Vasai West, in the Palghar district of Maharashtra. The 4.97-acre land parcel hosts 86 residences configured as 2 and 3 BHK homes, with possession targeted for December 2027. Usable carpet areas range from 716 sq ft for the smallest 2 BHK to 910 sq ft for the largest 3 BHK. Every unit is priced at a standard ₹11,500 per sq ft of carpet area, starting at ₹82.34 Lacs and going up to ₹1.04 Cr. The project offers more than two dozen amenities including a gymnasium, yoga and meditation areas, a jogging track, indoor games, a community hall, a multipurpose court and a party lawn. Infrastructure highlights include 24x7 water supply, rainwater harvesting, solar energy provisions, car and visitor parking, street lighting and CCTV security. The site is well connected to Vasai Road railway station, Vasai Fort and the Mumbai-Ahmedabad highway. Trinity Developers previously delivered a RERA-registered residential project in Vasai West, launched in 2017. Confirm the current price sheet and RERA certificate details before booking.

title: Sunteck Beach Residences
shortDescription: 2 & 3 BHK sea-facing homes in a 50-acre beachfront township on Suruchi Beach Road, Vasai West, starting ₹90 Lacs*. RERA registered, by Sunteck Realty.
description: Sunteck Beach Residences brings a rare beachfront township experience to Vasai West, spread across 50 acres on Suruchi Beach Road. Developed by Sunteck Realty — one of Mumbai's leading listed real estate companies known for landmark projects like Signature Island in BKC — this 4-tower, 30-storey development offers 2 and 3 BHK residences with direct beach access and panoramic sea views. Each tower comes with its own dedicated clubhouse, alongside over 50 shared amenities including a swimming pool, amphitheater, and children's play areas, supported by extensive basement and podium parking. With a sample flat ready for viewing and MahaRERA registration in place, Sunteck Beach Residences appeals to buyers seeking a large-scale, professionally managed luxury address by the sea, distinct from the smaller standalone towers typical of the Vasai market.
